question: How should input bytes be decoded, and should Unicode characters be normalized?
why_it_matters: The encoding and Unicode policy determine which files are accepted and whether visually similar text changes its character sequence.
recommendation_reason: UTF-8 with unchanged Unicode provides a portable contract without silently changing character content.

options.description: Decode strictly as UTF-8 and preserve Unicode characters without Unicode normalization.
Decode strictly as UTF-8 and apply Unicode NFC normalization.
Decode using the local system encoding and preserve Unicode without normalization.
